Title: Suspicious phishing email opened by finance user
Description: A finance user opened a simulated phishing email and clicked a credential-harvesting link. Review sign-in activity and mailbox rules.

Title: Impossible travel sign-in for student account
Description: A student account signed in from two distant locations within a short time window. Validate whether the activity is expected before closing the incident.

Title: Malware detected on Windows 11 lab VM
Description: Defender reported malware-like behavior on a Windows 11 lab virtual machine. Investigate device timeline and related process execution.

Title: Unusual download volume from SharePoint
Description: A user downloaded an unusually large number of SharePoint documents. Review user intent and affected files.

Title: Multiple failed RDP logons followed by success
Description: Repeated failed RDP logons were followed by a successful authentication. Confirm whether the source address and account owner are legitimate.
